title: Two particles at separation 2.5 to 3.5: the separation-5 pair table needs no radial factor

claims.statement: Two particles at rest, any pair of species in A, B, C, initial separation 2.5 to 3.5, T up to 2: the pure r^-2.5 law with the P-0005 separation-5 coefficients, with no radial factor, reproduces the tracker positions with error at most 0.013 (RMSE/10). Five runs: 2026-11-20/r2/lab-keystone/002 (A-C, 2.5), 003 (A-C, 3.5, T=2), 004 (B-B, 2.5), 005 (C-C, 2.5), 006 (A-A, 3.0). Fitted coefficients lie within 4% of the table.
